reviews.title: 2 stars.
reviews.text:
Ancestry has some great features, especially when it comes to searching records and communicating with other users researching the same family lines. The platform makes it easy to uncover information and connect the dots in your family history.
That said, it comes at a very steep price. What really frustrated me was discovering that even though I was already paying for the "pro" version, Ancestry still wanted more money to unlock additional features. The endless subscription tiers have gotten ridiculous. It feels like you're constantly being upsold after you've already paid for a premium service.
To make matters worse, I was shocked to learn about cancellation fees. Seriously, charging customers extra when they want to leave? WTH. Between the high subscription costs, feature paywalls, and cancellation charges, the value just isn't there for me anymore.
I'm all set. There are better ways to research family history without feeling nickel-and-dimed every step of the way.

reviews.title: Ancestry’s Discriminatory Treatment of Palestinians
reviews.text: Ancestry’s treatment of Palestinians is deeply biased and discriminatory. Its maps appear to erase Palestine while identifying virtually every other country, and its services are restricted in Palestine while remaining accessible to Israelis. This creates a clear and troubling disparity based on nationality and geographical location. I have raised these issues with Ancestry several times over the past few months, yet they remain unaddressed. Their continued failure to respond meaningfully raises serious concerns about whether this discrimination is deliberate. Ancestry should treat Palestinians with the same respect and provide them with the same access as everyone else.

reviews.title: Ancestry: How to turn something interesting and enjoyable into literal hell.
reviews.text:
Extremely frustrating and unreliable. I entered my family relationships correctly, yet Ancestry’s LifeStory described my father’s father as his mother, despite the relationship editor correctly listing him as the biological father. And then he never appeared on my physical tree with no way of displaying him there. 

After using Ancestry’s own duplicate-merge feature, my tree became even more confused. Children randomly appeared multiple times, incorrect family groups appeared, and existing relationships were displayed incorrectly.

The app provides very little explanation or control for fixing these problems. I’ve spent more time correcting issues created by Ancestry than actually researching my family history.

For a paid genealogy service, the family-tree functionality simply isn’t good enough.

reviews.text: Is this accurate as a lot has changed. My wife has done a test several years ago and her updated results are completely different.

reviews.title: Great service but app doesn’t work
reviews.text:
I’ve spent endless time on the website building my family tree, the access to documents is incredible. But the mobile and iPad apps don’t show the full tree, people are missing in some cases whole branches aren’t there. 

Doesn’t seem to be a case of it not refreshing as some more recent people appear where others added prior do not.  

This means I can’t share it with others as lots of it is missing?!

reviews.title: Dreadful app
reviews.text:
The website works perfectly but the app is just not built right. Editing facts are never saved, after clicking save they revert back to what was originally in the text. You simply can’t do everything you can on the website either. This all depends if it’s actually working as more often than not it says error and you can’t even access anything. Also cancelled my membership through the app and it continued to charge me and I had to do it again through the website. I recommend using the website but avoid the app!
EDIT 2026: Yet another update to remove buttons that were previously one click and now are buried, the app does not load properly, it does not save and that’s just the start. Do not use ancestry unless you like to waste your time! Family echo is so much better !

reviews.title: Ancestry
reviews.text:
A great app and worthy of 5 stars. Very easy to use to learn about your family, their history and background when it works!
I’ve logged in this morning 28.03.26 and my account shows 484 family members, but on my screen there are only 3?

HELP!!!

reviews.title: Limited and needs work
reviews.text: Years later, and this app is extremely limited and buggy. As expensive as Ancestry is, you would think they would have a better app, with better features and less bugs. When you try to add a result through the search feature on someone, it adds the incorrect item. It will randomly close, and the features aren’t nearly what they are on the desktop app. They keep increasing the membership price, but obviously aren’t spending it on the mobile app, or even the website, which has better features but also buggy and could be much better. Also, the app should allow you to pick the collections available on ancestry. Many records are missed due to incorrect transcription or variations in spelling. The search is extremely lacking and try’s to do it for someone instead of allowing the person to dig through records, which is how a lot of brick walls are torn down. Most of the “hints” are other people’s tree, which a lot of times, can be incorrect.

reviews.title: Interested of late
reviews.text: Life has been busy and taken me away from my initial interest in my ancestry but now - with more grandchildren and with me getting that much older - I realise that I have more knowledge in my hands to be able to relate to my family.  Ancestry and its knowledge will be very interesting.

reviews.title: 12 weeks no result
reviews.text: Sent in a sample in tandem with another person. They received their results within 6 weeks but mine stayed in “DNA extracted”. Only after I complained twice did they send me an email giving me a new kit, so they probably lost it. Sure it’s a rare event but people should be aware it happens.

reviews.title: Richard
reviews.text: Keeps making suggestions and asking questions with no means of answering them or correcting statements that are wrong!

reviews.title: CLICKBAIT APP
reviews.text: Had this as a gift and able to add a couple of things BUT totally UNABLE to correct errors to existing facts unless forced to PAY FOR UPGRADE… Nothing  more than CLICKBAIT seemingly on EVERYTHING I click on!!!

reviews.title: Too complex
reviews.text: I am finding the site increasingly complex to navigate when it used to be relatively simple.   May be it’s just me but I get an email regarding hints, click on the link and never get the hint!

reviews.title: Just don’t
reviews.text:
It’s been a nightmare since November that was almost 6 months ago. I purchased a kit and followed the instructions as stated in the kit. Send in the kit don’t hear anything until January. They tell me the sample is inconclusive. I ask how so, they tell me I didn’t have enough saliva. I filled it as directed. They ask if I brushed my teeth, I tell them yeah. And then they go to ask how long before you brushed your teeth did you take a sample. I tell them 30 minutes, they go to tell me that’s where I went wrong it has to be atleast 2 hours before taking test. It doesn’t state this anywhere on the kit. I say ok what the hell move along. They tell me they’ll send a replacement kit. Takes 2 more months until I purchase one as the replacement kit doesn’t arrive. I open the app and it informs me I have a replacement kit on standby that I need to replace. So I fill out the information again. The new kit I’m filling information out for will not allow me to input into the app. 


Don’t do business here, clearly the level of incompetence found herein is unbelievably high

reviews.title: V slow
reviews.text: Not had a result yet more than 6 weeks and free trial due to finish I wonder why it’s all delayed!

reviews.title: Moving goalposts
reviews.text: Constantly taking away features like which parent has given you which heritage. That used to be free.

reviews.title: DNA kit
reviews.text: Dry unclear in the testing . I purchased and sent back without activating so what next ?

reviews.title: Rubbish
reviews.text: Sent off for a test kit, sent it back and 2 months later no results. Plus I don’t remember signing up for a 3 month renewable membership so have cancelled that. Overall really disappointing.

reviews.title: Data on iPad incompatible with iPhone
reviews.text:
I only downloaded the App yesterday on my iPad. Spent many hours updating my family tree and verifying hints. 
Tried to login today and suddenly the App doesn’t like my IoS version (although I have the most updated 16.7.14)
I then opened the App on my iPhone and most of the data I entered yesterday has gone! I now can’t get access to verify some info which I could do on my iPad e.g. my parents marriage AND the format is very different from the iPad and very confusing. I’m thinking of cancelling!

reviews.title: Great idea Difficult to use
reviews.text: I really like finding out about my ancestry but I do find it very difficult to use, even more so on a phone. Theres also a lot of mistakes in data suggestions, even for those from our most recent generations.

reviews.title: WAY TOO EXPENSIVE!!!!!
reviews.text: I’m not paying for information that we should be able to access for free. It’s kind of ridiculous that they continue to take information away little by little to try to force you to spend money for information about our own family information. Not to mention the fact that they block documents that you have saved as well so you are also unable to see them. Why can’t I see things that I have saved unless I go broke lining their pockets for information that SHOULD BE FREE?!?! They claim that there is free information that you can access, but that is NOT TRUE. Nothing is free on here. I am going to have to take everything I have worked so hard on and move it to a different site that actually offers FREE information about my own family. It’s so frustrating. As for the DNA, 23andme may have their issues, but they have done a far better job. I have even been willing to pay $70 for a year with them for the extra info BECAUSE IT’S WORTH IT! The $40 plus whatever a month Ancestry wants, is not worth it. NOT EVEN CLOSE.
